how1: Chwetheza into abayithengayo (okanye ucofe 🍚 Irayisi, 20 lb bag ngamaxabiso okwenyani emarike).
how2: Faka iindleko zenye eUnited States (okanye ucofe itshiphu).
how3: Khetha ukuba umntu ngamnye ufumana ngaphi.
how4: Yongeza umamkeli ngamnye: cofa ilizwe, yongeza igama / isisa.
how5: Umqolo ngamnye ubonisa into emayithunyelwe; chwetheza ixabiso lokwenyani lendawo ukuba uyayazi.
how6: Iyonke isezantsi; cofa Khuphela isicwangciso ukwabelana.
how7: Okanye uvule uluhlu lweminqweno: khetha into abayifunayo, khuphela inowuthi, emva koko unikezele ngephepha lobuthunywa.
howp: Oku kucwangcisa iimali. Ayithumeli mali okanye ayiqinisekisi imibutho yesisa. Nika ngephepha elisemthethweni lobuthunywa ngalinye.
tagline: Nika ukuze umntu ngamnye athenge okufanayo.
nosend: Le app ayithumeli mali okanye iqinisekise amancedo. Nika ngephepha elisemthethweni lobuthunywa ngalinye.
about1: Amanqanaba exabiso avela kwiBhanki yehlabathi (izinga lexabiso lokusetyenziswa kwendlu, ubukhulu becala 2024; US = 100, egcinwe njenge-1.0). Amaxabiso otshintshiselwano ayasebenza namhlanje. Iindleko ezisemthethweni zelizwe = iindleko zase-US × i-PPP yayo ye-2024 yendlu, iguqulwe yaba yidola ngexabiso lanamhlanje. Amaxabiso asemthethweni ziindleko zokuphila, hayi into enye yegrosari kwaye hayi ireyithi yanamhlanje yocingo. Chwetheza ixabiso xa elona liyaziwa (eliboniswe “njengexabiso lakho”).
about2: isebenzisa amaxabiso erayisi emarike yokwenyani endaweni yexabiso lexabiso: I-US evela kwi-Bureau of Labor Statistics (uchungechunge APU0000701312, i-avareji yesixeko sase-US), iHaiti kunye neMalawi kwiNkqubo yoKutya yeHlabathi (nge-HDX). Amaxabiso asekuhlaleni ajikwa abe ziidola ngezinga lanamhlanje. 20 lb = 9.07 kg. Amazwe angenaxabiso lerayisi kwimarike asebenzisa inqanaba lexabiso.
about3: Amaxabiso e-Wishlist ngamaxabiso okuthengisa e-World Food Programme (nge-HDX) kwindawo yemishini, kunye nemarike kunye nenyanga eboniswe kwinto nganye. Izinto ezingenaxabiso lemarike zithi "ixabiso elibekwe ngumsebenzi".
sentence: IUnited States ithunyelwe {a} ( {b} × {n} ). Yonke enye indawo ithunyelwa iindleko zayo ngokuphindwe kwalelo nani.
rates_unavail: ⚠ Amaxabiso akhoyo akafumaneki — usebenzisa iWorld Bank 2024 amazinga kunye namanqanaba amaxabiso.
wl_intro: Imishini ayikwazi ukufumana iipakethe ezizisiweyo; bathenga kwiimarike zabo zasekuhlaleni. Khetha oko kufunwa yimishini, emva koko unike kwiphepha layo kunye nenqaku elingezantsi ukuze imali ithenge ezi zinto ekuhlaleni.
wl_give_hint: Khuphela inowuthi, ucofe ku-Nikeza ngokuthe ngqo, kwaye ulincamathisele kwinowuthi yesipho okanye kwibhokisi yememo.
wl_shared_warn: Uluhlu lweminqweno ekwabelwana ngalo: lwenziwe nguye nabani na othumele ikhonkco. Jonga ikhonkco lokupha liphepha lokwenyani lobuthunywa.
wl_m_items: Izinto, enye ngomgca: igama | ixabiso lendawo (shiya ixabiso lingenanto ukuba liyatshintsha)
wl_bad: Yongeza igama, ikhonkco le-https:// kunye nokuba yinto enye.
